comments.author: Sumit Gupta 📊
comments.comment: Shipping agentic AI taught me that most RAG failures are retrieval and eval gaps, not model choice. I start with a tiny golden set and measure recall@k, precision@k, and answer faithfulness before adding agents. Which repo helped you debug RAG failures fastest? #RAG #AIEvals

comments.author: Useful Infographics
comments.comment: Agent reliability comes from the harness, not the prompt. I move every deterministic check into code and leave models for judgment. If a required check can fail silently, the workflow needs a hard gate, not a stronger instruction. Which check in your agent still depends on prompt compliance? #AgenticAI

comments.author: Shirin Khosravi Jam
comments.comment: Most vibe-coding failures are not model failures; they are missing repo-level constraints. I’d prioritize deterministic hooks and review gates before smarter prompts. Which guardrail has actually prevented a bad merge for you? #AgenticAI

comments.author: Heiko Scherrer
comments.comment: Agentic PR pipelines live or die on the reviewer bottleneck. I’d gate the agent on a machine readable acceptance test, not just a human approving the diff. How do you stop agents from solving the ticket while missing the product constraint? #AIAgents
